summary.text: Jim Walkowicz is the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan's 9th District. He has appeared on this district's general-election ballot in earlier cycles.

paragraphs.text: Appeared on the general-election ballot for this district in 2022 and 2024, losing to Rep. Lisa McClain both times.
Advanced from the Working Class Party convention on June 6, 2026.
